question: Should `crabbox sync-plan` expose this stable `--json` output contract for CI and agent preflights now?
rationale: This adds a new public machine-readable CLI surface whose field names and status values become compatibility commitments, and the repository has no existing JSON contract for this command.

options.title: Accept after proof
options.body: Keep the current implementation direction, require redacted real CLI output, and merge after contract review.

options.title: Narrow or mark experimental
options.body: Ask for a smaller or explicitly experimental JSON shape if maintainers want less compatibility commitment.

options.title: Defer public JSON
options.body: Pause or close the PR if maintainers do not want this command to publish a stable JSON contract yet.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof
recommendation.body: Keep the current implementation direction, require redacted real CLI output, and merge after contract review.
